blurb: Guests can experience the Halifax Harbour by the hour or full day excursions including sunset tours, boating and hiking tours, and full day private boat tours. They also offer deep sea fishing tours and transportation services such as round trip ferry service to Birch & Anchor with dining options. The tours provide unique views of Halifax from the water and opportunities for social and corporate events.

quotes.author: Alanna Pyke
quotes.text: I recently booked a corporate event with Halifax Boat Tours and the whole experience was awesome. Eric was great during the booking process. He made booking easy, and was very responsive and flexible to accommodate our group. We chose to do the boat tour and hike at McNab’s Island. Kody took us out and we all had a great time! His knowledge of the island really impressed us. He gave us lots of time to explore and even told us the best spots to get pictures at. Overall it was an awesome day and I would 100% book again with Halifax Boat Tours for another event 😊 Thanks Eric and Kody!

quotes.author: Marilyn M
quotes.text: We just did an afternoon boat tour with Cody today and we all loved it! Great tour of Halifax from the water, view you wouldn’t normally get as a local growing up here and very eye opening. Cody provided some fun facts and history along the way also and was very friendly and even went over some waves for us for fun. We also had the perfect weather so that helped.

quotes.author: Chris S
quotes.text: A lovely tour by Halifax Boat Tours. Cody was very informative and took us on a wonderful tour of McNabs Island followed by a cruise of the Harbour and surrounding area. I highly recommend them for any social event. They are so accommodating and easy going. This is the best social event our company has had in a very long time. Thank you!!!

quotes.author: brittany sheppard
quotes.text: If I could leave more then 5 stars I absolutely would can’t say more about Cody and Eric both where fantastic from booking to accommodating our group to the actual tour these guys blow the other boat tours out of the water no one better to take you on a tour of the harbour!!! Keep up the good work guys!

quotes.author: East Coast Power Sport Adventures
quotes.text: Not only are we their dock neighbours but we got to enjoy a boat tour tonight and we had an absolute blast! Y’all are the best.

quotes.author: Jacob Robinson
quotes.text: Kody was fantastic! Really enjoyed our harbour tour and trip to Birch and Anchor.
